the adopted WAI-ARIA 1.2 aria-modal property definition, which specifies that assistive technology should restrict its reading and navigation to the modal element while it is active, directly requires background content to be excluded from that navigation — this is the primary source for "unreachable by ... screen-reader virtual cursor." The already-adopted WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.3 Focus Order and SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured support, but do not by themselves fully dictate, this outcome for pointer/sequential-navigation reachability.
